Giving back · 1 for 1

We sell out & help out.

Every roll, plate and cake you buy means one more goes to a food pantry or a family in need. Every single order.

How we help out

$15 meals that fed two

To taste-test our new menu, we sold full-size meals (normally $35–$45) for $15 with a free dessert. For every meal purchased, we donated one to someone in need.
